Hi, and welcome to our office in New York. We are a small fintech. There are two floors. On the first floor, there is a small coffee shop, and there are tables for clients. On the second floor, there is the technology team. There are twenty people on the team. There is not a big meeting room, but there are four small rooms for calls. Okay, let's go up.

Hello, I am Priya. I am an engineer at a bank in Mumbai, in India. My bank is very big. There are offices in every city, and there are many stores that use our cards. There is a team for credit cards, and I am on that team. There are many calls with partners in other countries. My English is good, but my accent is from India!
